left.raw_text: Presence of a significant medical or psychiatric condition

(Examples include: Diagnosis and treatment of tuberculosis (TB) or HIV; renal insufficiency; hepatic disease; oral or parenteral medication known to affect the immune function, such as corticosteroids, other immunosuppressant drugs; or behavioural or memory issues)
Ever having received oral cholera vaccine.
Receipt of an investigational product (within 30 days before vaccination).
History of diarrhoea in 7 days prior to first dose of vaccine

right.raw_text: (defined as =3 unformed loose stools in 24 hours).

left.raw_text: History of chronic diarrhea (lasting for more than 2 weeks in the past 6 months)
